formfinding.name: Form Finding: Rules, Constraints and Possible Shapes
formfinding.v1_note: Local source and desktop pass, 2026-09-19. Six halls retained; manuscript, restored comparisons, controlled relaxation and explicitly separated search stops aligned. Source and capture scopes are recorded in doc/book/iterations/2026-09-19-formfinding-review/SUMMARY.md. Headset and learner validation remain open.
formfinding.truth: A chosen update, objective and set of constraints make some configurations accessible. An accepted endpoint depends on the model and its stopping rule.
formfinding.qfep_connection: Compare how models define a cost, constrain variation and accept an endpoint. This is a methodological connection; the exhibits do not establish that physical energy, numerical objective and variational free energy are interchangeable.
